test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 5 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

NARROW
solution: The correct answer is '**wide**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate antonym of the given word '**Narrow**' is '**Wide**'. • **Narrow**: having only a short distance from side to side. (तंग, संकीर्ण) • *Example: The bridge is too **narrow** for two cars to pass.* • **Wide**: measuring a lot from one side to the other. (चौड़ा, विस्‍मीर्ण) • *Example: The road was not **wide** enough for two cars to pass.* **Correct Answer:__** *Wide.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the **meaning **of other words: • **Tight**: fixed firmly in position and difficult to move or remove. (किसी स्‍थान पर कसकर बँधा हुआ (जिसका हिलना या जिसे हिलाना कठिन हो)) • **Firm**: able to stay the same shape when pressed; quite hard. (सख्‍़त; सुदृढ़, काफ़ी कड़ा) • **Solid**: hard and firm; not in the form of liquid or gas. (कड़ा और पक्‍का; द्रव या गैस नहीं, ठोस) 42:Tfcb, The correct answer is **'you are enjoy'**.
